qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits register-indexed qword BTR only at the measured fixture RIP with RCX as the index. The same operation at another RIP declines.
admission.implementation: The existing signed bit-string address lowering stages the exact adjusted qword address, performs one replay-safe read, clears only the selected bit, and commits through one final transactional write. CF publishes only after the write succeeds.
admission.deferred: All other unmeasured memory BTR/BTS/BTC forms retain their prior paths.

verification.focusedGate: 218 tests in DoryARM64BaselineJITTests, DoryARM64Tier1JITTests, DoryX86BitTestAddressingTests, and DoryX86IRTests passed.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,448 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Indices 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65 match the interpreter for initially clear and set bits while preserving every unselected bit.
verification.rollbackCoverage: An injected final-write page fault leaves flags, RIP, registers, and backing memory at the block-entry checkpoint.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed difference is reported for completeness and is not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured write-side memory BTR site is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 128,014 of 226,761 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
